findings: Unit --lora parses its value with parse_csv_row, so unescaped comma paths are not a single literal pinned adapter.
Nonunit --lora-scaled parses CSV entries then splits EVERY colon and requires exactly2parts. A Windows drive path adds another colon and cannot be passed as-is at nonunit scale.
The previous last-colon assumption was incorrect; unit Windows drive paths remain supported because --lora does not split colons.
bounded_fix: Reject comma in any configured adapter path; reject colon only for nonunit scale; keep unit --lora PATH and all pin/default/profile behavior unchanged. No CSV quoting feature added.
